name: Tesslan Wrap Skirt with Tail Slit
description: A knee-length wrap skirt in a loose linen-blend weave, available in deep terracotta and pale sand. The rear panel has a vertical slit that runs 25cm down from the waistband, finished with clean hems on both sides — it parts naturally around a tail and falls back into place at rest. The wrap construction means the waist adjusts freely, accommodating hip geneware variations. Simple, wearable, draws on South Asian wrap traditions.
functionality: Vertical rear slit accommodates tail geneware of varied thickness; wrap waist adjusts for hip geneware variation
what_it_says: You dress with some care and you've found a cut that doesn't treat your geneware as a problem to engineer around.
worn_by: people who prefer skirts to trousers
story_hooks: A character's skirt slit is wider than the standard cut — someone altered it carefully, suggesting a previous owner with an unusually large tail.
The terracotta dye lot is notoriously inconsistent; two people in identical skirts look like they're wearing completely different garments.

physical_description.visual_profile: A flowing, asymmetrical wrap skirt that drapes naturally from the hips with graceful movement. The silhouette is deliberately loose and accommodating, with a distinctive rear vertical slit that creates visual interest and functional adaptation. Reads as deliberately cultural and practical rather than fashion-forward.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed and adjustable wrap construction; sits low on hips with generous room through thighs and calves. Designed to flex around augmented or naturally variant body geometry. Knee-length with natural diagonal hem from the wrap overlap.
physical_description.primary_material: Linen-blend weave in natural fibers — breathable, slightly structured, ages gracefully with wear
physical_description.texture: Soft slub surface with visible fiber variation; light drape with subtle texture that catches light; unhardened weave gives lived-in character immediately
physical_description.color_scheme: Two tones offered: deep terracotta (warm rust-orange) or pale sand (cream-beige). Monochromatic with natural linen undertones; no pattern, relies on fabric weave and drape for visual depth
physical_description.closures: Wrap-style fastening with overlap closure; no zippers or buttons — friction-fit and body weight maintain closure
distinctive_features: Rear vertical slit (25cm from waist) with clean, finished hems on both sides
Designed to accommodate tail augmentations or natural morphologies
Wrap construction allows mid-wear adjustment for comfort
South Asian textile tradition reference in cut and construction
Minimal visible branding — maker's weave mark only
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3–4 functional wear with cultural specificity; accessible pricing but thoughtful design suggests maker awareness
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer signals: practical adaptation to augmentation diversity, cultural rootedness, comfort with body variance, street-aware but not aggressively modded. Popular among mixed-heritage communities, geneware carriers, and those rejecting corpo standardization.
physical_description.condition_typical: Breaks in quickly with soft wrinkles and natural creasing at hip and slit; edges fray slightly with age but remain functional; develops personalized patina of wear
